FAQs

BIMM is an app that gives you access to exclusive deals and offers at restaurants and cafes. Just subscribe, browse deals near you, and save on every meal.

Download the app, enable subscription, and start browsing deals. When you find one you like, book it for a date and time, then show up and swipe to check in — it's that simple.

Loyalty cards are free, but you'll need to pay for the subscription to get access to Deals. Premium costs 49 NOK a month, or 295 NOK a year (24.58 NOK/month) — both with a 7-day free trial. You can cancel at any time.

Yes, you can cancel anytime. Your access stays active until the end of your current billing period — no hidden fees or cancellation penalties.

Open the BIMM app, find a deal you want, and book it for a date and time. At the venue, swipe to check in and show it to the staff.

BIMM is developed by a team of passionate developers from Oslo, Norway. We believe in making dining out more accessible and enjoyable for everyone.
